title: If math is more than proof, we need to better celebrate the rest of it
summary: A Terry Tao blog post arguing that mathematics should be valued beyond formal proof, celebrating intuition, exploration, exposition, and other contributions. The Hacker News discussion (363 points, 269 comments) debates how AI/ML tools like LLMs and proof assistants may reshape mathematical practice, and whether the field's culture over-rewards theorem-proving at the expense of other essential work.
